extension.summary: Repository of small, hand-picked Kodi addon fixes
extension.description: Hosts addons that have been forked and patched for a specific CoreELEC/Aeon Nox 5 setup. Currently: CU LRC Lyrics (DC Version) - lyrics sync/scraper/OK-OSD fixes; DC Artist Artwork DL - rotating artist fanart background service; Aeon Nox 5 Skin Fixes - companion skin patches both of those need; and a network watchdog for boots where the LAN doesn't come up on its own. See the repository README for the full list, plus manual-install remote keymaps that aren't installable addons.

extension.news: 1.35.7: ported two fixes/features from the sibling script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed (both found and confirmed live there first, same underlying code): (1) Song.by_offset() no longer replaces '/' or '\\' in the artist/title read from Kodi's infolabels with ' & ' - this silently corrupted any real band name containing a literal slash (e.g. AC/DC became "AC & DC" in every lyrics/translation search); Kodi's own library scanner already handles genuine multi-artist separator splitting, so this second replace was never correct. (2) the "Interface & translation language" setting now auto-detects and matches Kodi's own system/skin language once, on first service startup after install (a marker file in the addon's profile dir tracks whether this has run) - stays fully manually changeable afterward exactly as before, per user request. 1.35.6: fixed a real bug in the KaraokeTexty scraper - _karaoketexty_find_url() used to scrape the site's own crude '/search?q=artist+title' HTML results page, which for a well-known song frequently returns a lower-quality duplicate entry (bare original lyrics, no translation column at all) instead of the real, properly-categorized page that actually has one, confirmed live for AC/DC - Back in Black. Found (by reading the site's own JS) that its search box autocomplete actually calls a separate, much better JSON search API (search.karaoketexty.cz), and that the site redirects ANY URL for a song's real numeric id to its own correct canonical artist/title slug regardless of what slug text is in the request - so this no longer scrapes a results page or guesses a slug at all: queries the real JSON API by title (an artist+title combined query returned nothing for this API, title alone works and ranks the real match first by view count), matches the returned artist label against the actual artist (handling the site's own 'ϟ' stand-in for a literal '/' in that field), then fetches a dummy-slug URL with that id and follows the site's own redirect to get the correct final URL. This makes the 1.34.0 artist-slug-validation safety net (which could only ever reject a wrong match, never find the right one once the crude search returned something else) obsolete - removed along with its now-unused _slugify() helper. Confirmed live: now finds and successfully aligns 57 real Slovak translation lines for AC/DC - Back in Black (translator credited: Azurit), where it previously always fell through to machine translation. 1.35.5: fixed the deepl_api_key setting field not appearing in the settings UI at all (found and fixed in the sibling script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed first, same bug present here too since both share this settings.xml block). Real cause per kodi.wiki/view/Add-on_settings_conversion: a type="string" setting with a genuinely empty default needs an explicit <constraints><allowempty>true</allowempty></constraints> block, or Kodi's CSettingString validator rejects the empty default as invalid and drops the setting entirely with no crash pointing at the real cause. 1.35.4: reverted the 1.35.3 crash mitigation the same day it was added - confirmed live it broke completely normal playback (no skin switch involved): xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowDialogId() == self.getId() evaluated false even during a plain, undisturbed song, silently killing refresh()'s Timer self-rescheduling chain after its very first tick and freezing lyric sync at line 1 forever. That's a worse, permanent, everyday failure - trading a rare crash for an always-broken feature is not a fix. The _gui_still_alive() method is left in place but unused as a reminder not to re-add this exact check without first understanding why the id comparison doesn't hold during normal operation. 1.35.3: found and mitigated a real crash - switching skins live while a song was playing (AN5 for ~1 minute, then to Estuary) crashed the whole Kodi process, confirmed via the crash log: XBMCAddon::xbmcgui::ControlList::getSelectedPosition() SIGSEGV on a null/freed control. A live skin switch tears down this addon's dialog window at the Kodi-core level without calling any Python close hook, so a background thread (the refresh() Timer chain, or the translation fetch thread) that then touches self.text/etc can segfault the whole process - a genuine native crash, not a Python exception, so no try/except could ever catch it (refresh() already had a bare one, confirmed not enough). Added a _gui_still_alive() check (compares xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowDialogId() against this dialog's own id) before every such background-thread control access. This narrows the race but can't mathematically close it - there's still a small gap between the check and the call it guards. Confirmed live: repeating the exact same AN5-to-Estuary switch after 1 minute of playback no longer crashes. 1.35.2: sync-offset slider position marker recolored to a pale sky blue, per user request. 1.35.1: the sync-offset slider's position marker still didn't render after two texture attempts (textureslidernib, then also textureslidernibfocus since the control always has default focus) - gave up on Kodi's native slider nib rendering entirely and replaced it with a plain image control that sync.py positions explicitly via setPosition() every time the value changes, using the same left/width math as the slider itself. Confirmed live: a clearly visible orange marker now moves along the bar and matches the numeric readout. 1.35.0: reverted the current-line style-cycling back to Aeon Nox 5's original mod-15 digit sequence, per user request - the mod-17 widening added 2026-09-05 (to fit 2 new custom styles, LyricsW "wiggle" and LyricsB "balloon pop") shifted every line's assigned style off of AN5's own, and both extra styles are now removed along with their 2 now-orphaned font tokens (culrc_titanone_110, culrc_bangers_120). The remaining 15 styles' own digit-to-style mapping was rebuilt from AN5's real shipped skin.aeon.nox.5/1080i/Includes_VideoLyrics.xml directly, not guessed. Also fixed the sync-offset slider window (up/down during timed lyrics) rendering only its 2 text labels with no background box or slider bar at all on any skin, confirmed live - a rectangle-type control with no texture and a slider-type control with no explicit bar/nib textures both turned out to render as literally nothing, not fall back to any Kodi built-in graphic as assumed. Switched both to this addon's own already-proven culrc-black.png/culrc-white70.png assets. 1.34.0: KaraokeTexty search results are now verified against the artist actually being searched for before being accepted - confirmed live 2026-09-07 that the site's own search can return a completely unrelated song as its first/only hit (searching "Aerosmith I Don't Want To Miss A Thing" returned a Disturbed song on .sk and a Jet song on .cz); align_by_content() already caught the resulting mismatch downstream and fell back to machine translation safely, but silently, after a wasted fetch+alignment pass - now rejected immediately with a clear log line instead. Translation panel: logo enlarged ~30% (130 to 169px), the logo/translation divider shortened to leave equal space above and below (was flush with the panel's bottom edge), and the line-change slide+fade transition slowed down and made more pronounced (220ms/18px to 800ms/36px) after it still read as an abrupt cut at the faster setting. 1.33.1: replaced the translation panel's fade-dip line-change transition with a slide+fade-in ("arriving") one - the fade dip read as a blink/flicker rather than motion (opacity alone carries no sense of direction). Slides the whole line group up 18px while fading in from 55% opacity, reversible="false" so it only ever plays forward - a reversible version would visibly slide back down the instant pulse dropped back to 0, undoing the effect right after it arrived. 1.33.0: fixed the translation panel's bottom margin - it was only 10px from the screen edge, not matching the 45px left/right margins, because the panel height increase for the font bump didn't account for this window's own +40px Y coordinate offset (screen bottom is effectively at XML y=1040, not 1080). Shifted the whole panel up and re-measured properly: bottom margin is now 46px, left is 45px, confirmed by direct pixel sampling on a live screenshot. Down to 2 lines of context below the current line (from 3) to fit the corrected, more constrained vertical budget. Fade-pulse line-change transition made more noticeable (was barely perceptible: 25% dip over 300ms; now 65% dip over 200ms). 1.32.0: translation panel fonts increased another ~15% (19/42b to 22/42b - current line 36b to 42b, a new fontinstall.py token), 4 lines of context below the current line reduced to 3 so the taller panel still fits on screen (4 would have pushed the last row past the bottom edge at 1080p). 1.31.1: fixed a real font-install bug found live 2026-09-07 - AN5 lost all its decorative fonts and the translation panel's bigger current-line font after a plain skin switch back from Confluence, because font_patch_asked.json had AN5 marked as "already asked" from an earlier boot-time race (install() likely ran before the skin was fully ready and returned early, before ever writing font_patch_state.json) while font_patch_state.json itself never actually listed AN5 as installed - auto_install_if_needed() was gating the install() call itself on "not already asked", so it silently never retried, on any future boot or skin switch, forever. already_asked() now only dedupes the one-time success notification; the actual install attempt always retries until the skin genuinely appears in installed_skins(). 1.31.0: list 112 (translation) no longer needs real window focus at all - two focus-based approaches (plain list + lookahead-scroll, then <control type="fixedlist"> + <focusposition>) both failed to reliably show "1 line above, bigger current line" on a clean restart, confirmed on both Aeon Nox 5 and Confluence (root cause of the AN5 failures turned out to be unrelated - see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.12.0 - but the Confluence failures were real). Replaced with fixed offset labels reading Container(112).ListItem(N).Label, the same technique the main lyrics text already uses - deterministic by construction, no runtime layout guessing. Also: fixed the translation-panel logo texture (was referencing a stray near-blank leftover icon, now uses special://xbmc/media/icon256x256.png), pushed the source textbox further down, removed the now-dead onClick(112)/defaultcontrol wiring, added a fade-pulse transition on line change (culrc.translation.pulse, real sliding-list scroll would need each row to track its own position - too much risk for a cosmetic feature right now), and increased the translation panel's font sizes ~20% (16/30b to 19/36b, two new fontinstall.py tokens). 1.30.0: the translation panel was fully rebuilt - a full-width dark band across the bottom of the screen (not the old left/right split), logo + source in a left column, a divider, and the translated text scrolling to the right with the current line bigger and bold. Several real fixes along the way: (1) the translation panel's fonts (font_culrc_line/current/meta) were never-loaded bare names, same class of bug 1.28.0 already found and fixed for the current-line display - now uses real culrc_notosans_16/20/30b/34b/48b tokens installed via fontinstall.py, same mechanism as the decorative fonts. (2) A bigger/bold current line needs Kodi's native focusedlayout, which needs real control focus - giving list 112 real focus (via <defaultcontrol>112</defaultcontrol>) reopened the exact OK-button/OSD bug this fork's very first commit already fixed for list 110 (OK goes to onClick() instead of onAction()'s OSD-open handling) - fixed by adding a matching onClick(112) branch in gui.py that forwards to the same close-dialog/open-OSD logic, since unlike 110, list 112 has no click-to-seek behavior of its own to conflict with it. (3) Getting exactly 1 line of context above the current line (with the rest below) turned out to be unreliable with a plain <control type="list"> - selectItem() always snaps its target to the nearest viewport edge when it has to scroll, never an exact offset, so no combination of lookahead tricks gave a stable count. Switched list 112 to <control type="fixedlist"> with <focusposition>1</focusposition> - a real Kodi control purpose-built for "focused item always at a fixed on-screen slot" (same mechanism skin.confluence uses for its album coverflow) - which fixed this immediately and let _select_translation_line() collapse back down to a single plain selectItem(pos) call. 1.29.11: fixed a real bug found live via a screenshot's raw pixel values - the 1.29.9 universal rotating fanart background left a dark, uncovered band along the top and left edges instead of filling the whole screen. Root cause: this dialog's window declares a <coordinates> offset (left=10, top=40) that applies to every control inside it, including the fanart background, which was positioned at plain (0,0) - counter-offset it to (-10,-40) so the effective on-screen position is really (0,0). 1.29.10: fixed a real gap found live - this addon's own sk_SK summary/description in addon.xml were simply missing entirely (only en_US/cs_CZ/de_DE/es_ES existed), despite Slovak being one of the 5 languages this addon fully maintains strings.po translations for - Kodi's add-on browser showed a completely blank description for a Slovak-language install. Added both. 1.29.9: the rotating artist-fanart background (service.xderecx.musicfanart) now works on ANY skin, not just Aeon Nox 5 - added the same generic background image control (reads Window(Visualisation).Property(ArtistSlideshow.Image), invisible/no-op if that service isn't installed) directly into this add-on's own bundled dialog, instead of it only ever being patched into Aeon Nox 5's copy by script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix. The control has zero skin-specific dependencies - just a Window property any installed copy of that service sets regardless of active skin. 1.29.8: fixed a real crash found live testing 1.29.7's sync-dialog fallback - opening the sync slider then never touching it (it auto-closes after 4s idle) crashed with AttributeError: 'GUI' object has no attribute 'val', since self.val was only ever set inside onAction(), which never fires if the user makes no input at all before the idle timeout. lib/sync.py now defaults self.val to the original offset (no change) in onInit(), before the idle-timeout loop starts. 1.29.7: fixed a real crash found live testing 1.29.4's dialog rename - the sync-offset slider (context menu "Sync", or up/down during timed lyrics) opens script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml, a file that only ever existed as an Aeon Nox 5-specific addition from script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix (added in 1.2.0), never bundled as a generic fallback the way the main dialog got one back in 1.24.0 - crashed outright ("XML File for Window is missing") on every other skin. Added resources/skins/Default/1080i/script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml, a plain skin-independent version using only control types/attributes guaranteed to work anywhere (a <rectangle> instead of <image> for the background so it needs no texture file, no slider texture overrides so it falls back to Kodi's own built-in slider graphics, no <font> tag so it falls back to the active skin's own default font) - also fixed the WindowXMLDialog construction call, which was missing the '1080i' resolution argument the main dialog's own call already has, needed for Kodi to find this bundled file at all. 1.29.6: the automatic decorative-font install (1.29.5) now also re-checks on a LIVE skin switch (Settings > Interface > Skin), not just once at Kodi's next boot/service-start - Kodi's Monitor.onSettingsChanged fires for any settings change, including the skin setting, so gui.py's existing update_settings() handler (already wired to that callback) now also calls the same fontinstall.auto_install_if_needed() check default.py runs at boot. Without this, switching skins mid-session would leave the newly-active skin's fonts uninstalled until Kodi happened to restart for some unrelated reason. 1.29.5: decorative fonts (for the current-line display) now install automatically, once per skin, at Kodi boot if the active skin doesn't have them yet - no confirmation dialog, just a brief notification once it's done and a reminder that a Kodi restart is needed. Previously this required manually finding "Install decorative fonts into the active skin" in this add-on's own settings, which nothing would ever prompt a user to go looking for - a fresh install on a new skin nobody had run it on by hand just silently rendered in the skin's own fallback font/size forever. The manual settings button (and "Remove decorative fonts") are unchanged and still there. 1.29.4: renamed the bundled dialog file from script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml to script-cu-lrclyrics-advanced-main.xml - Kodi's WindowXMLDialog prefers a skin's own file over the addon's bundled one whenever the names match exactly, and skins built for the original upstream CU LRC Lyrics addon (Confluence, Bello 10, and presumably others) ship their own native override of that exact filename, silently hijacking this dialog with their old, pre-fork layout - confirmed live under skin.bello.10 as a hard crash ("RuntimeError: Non-Existent Control 112", the translation list control added long after those skins' own copies were built). No skin has (or can have) a pre-existing override for the new fork-specific name, so this addon's own bundled dialog now renders on every skin, not just ones without a stale native override. script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.11.3+ patches Aeon Nox 5 to the new filename too. Also added a defensive fallback (getControl(112) wrapped in try/except with a no-op stand-in) so a skin with some OTHER still-unknown native override doesn't crash outright even before this fix's real solution kicks in - translation just quietly reports unavailable via a notification instead. Also fixed the same stale "3 fonts" wording in the font-install setting's help text (all 5 maintained languages) - it now correctly says 12. 1.29.3: widened the current-line style trigger from mod-15 to mod-17 to add 2 brand-new entrance styles of our own - LyricsW "wiggle" (continuous native Kodi pulse="true" rotate wiggle layered under a slide+zoom entrance) and LyricsB "balloon pop" (zoom-inflate past 100% then a fast zoom+fade "pop") - while leaving all 15 Aeon Nox 5-ported styles' own choreography completely untouched; only their trigger line-number condition changed to fit the new 17-slot partition (verified programmatically: 0 collisions and 0 uncovered line numbers for currentitem values 1-300). Font set: dropped Faster One, added Staatliches and Titan One (both full Slovak/Czech diacritic coverage, OFL-licensed) for 12 families total, split into "original" (Exo2, Ranchers, Luckiest Guy) and "added" groups. Also fixed a pre-existing bug where the translation-line display's font tags referenced bare unsized font names (culrc_exo2/culrc_ranchers/culrc_luckiestguy) that were never defined in fontinstall.py, silently falling back to the skin default font - now use the correct sized variants. 1.29.2: added 8 more decorative fonts (Agbalumo, Alfa Slab One, Bangers, Bowlby One SC, Faster One, Playball, Racing Sans One, Rubik Dirt) alongside the original 3 (Exo2, Ranchers, Luckiest Guy) - 11 families total now cycled across the 15 entrance styles, chosen by the user from 94 sample images rendered and reviewed first (all 120 candidates were Google Fonts "Display" category, checked for full Slovak/Czech diacritic coverage with fontTools - 94 passed, including a real rejection: plain "Bowlby One" is missing most diacritics, "Bowlby One SC" was used instead since it has full coverage). All are OFL/Apache licensed per Google Fonts policy, license text fetched from google/fonts on GitHub for each. Verified programmatically (not just by eye) that every one of the 15+8 style/companion blocks' effect combinations still match Aeon Nox 5's own file exactly, word for word - 0 discrepancies across 23 blocks - after an initial spot-check using a flawed text-search comparison method falsely flagged several as mismatched. 1.29.1: per live feedback that all 15 styles looked the same font SIZE despite different typefaces - they were, since lib/fontinstall.py only defined 3 fonts at nearly identical sizes (82-88pt) regardless of which of the 15 styles was showing. Read the real size of all 34 Aeon Nox 5 font tokens directly from skin.aeon.nox.5/1080i/Font.xml (they vary hugely - Lyrics12's scrolling marquee is 275pt, secondary "b" lines are 52-62pt, most main words are 104-220pt) and now generate 25 distinct (font family, real size) combinations instead of 3 flat sizes, so switching between styles now also means a real size jump, not just a typeface change. 1.29.0: full faithful port of all 15 of Aeon Nox 5's actual entrance styles (not the 5-style approximation from 1.28.4) - including their REAL per-style positions and color palettes, not just the animation effects. Found by reading two files together: skin.aeon.nox.5/1080i/Includes_VideoLyrics.xml on the box (the actual animation/layout definitions - grouplist auto-flow, per-word staggered cascades, combined slide+zoom+rotate, rotatex/rotatey 3D flips, multi-hundred-degree spins, a scrolling marquee style) and this repo's own aeonnox5lyricsfix .dat patch file (which only *references* these via include content=, but is where each style's real invocation position and color parameters actually live - the Includes file alone doesn't have them). Deliberately did NOT copy Aeon Nox 5's 3x-copy-with-tiny-pixel-offset manual drop-shadow trick (each style invoked 3 times, first 2 default-black for a hand-drawn shadow, 3rd real color) - this addon's existing shadowcolor attribute gives a similar look with one control instead of three. 34 distinct Aeon Nox 5 fonts collapsed onto this addon's 3 legally-bundleable ones (Exo2, Ranchers, Luckiest Guy - see 1.28.0's news for why Nasalization and others are excluded), cycled across the 15 styles. Mod-15 digit matching (not mod-10) guarantees consecutive line positions can never repeat a style - true for a +1 step against any modulus greater than 1, not just a lucky coincidence of the specific digit pairs chosen. Translation (Container 112) intentionally keeps its existing simpler single-style treatment, matching how Aeon Nox 5's own file only applies this 15-style system to the main lyric line too. 1.28.4: per direct user feedback about a pattern of over-simplifying Aeon Nox 5's design instead of porting it faithfully, restored the FULL 5-style system (not the 3-style consolidation from 1.28.0-1.28.3) with Aeon Nox 5's own exact digit pairs (1+6 slide-top, 3+8 slide-left, 5+0 zoom-in 0%-100%, 7+2 slide-right, 9+4 zoom-shrink-landing 400%-100%) and exact timings (250ms, sine/out for slides). The 3-style version's real bug (contiguous digit ranges breaking the every-line-animates guarantee) is fixed either way now, but going back to all 5 styles matches the actual reference instead of a reduced approximation of it. Verified programmatically (not just by eye) that no two consecutive digits, including the 9-to-0 wraparound, share a style. Only 3 decorative fonts are legally bundleable (see 1.28.0's news for why Nasalization is excluded), so they're reused across the 5 styles rather than reducing style count to match font count. 1.28.3: found and fixed the real cause of "animation almost never plays" (confirmed live: only 1-2 times per minute) - the 3 entrance styles were mapped to CONTIGUOUS digit ranges (0-3/4-6/7-9), so a run of consecutive same-range digits (e.g. line positions ending in 0,1,2,3 in a row) stayed inside the same already-visible style-group with no hidden->visible transition, meaning no Visible-trigger animation for 3 of every 4 line changes - only the actual group-boundary crossings ever animated. Aeon Nox 5's own digit pairs (1+6, 3+8, 5+0, 7+2, 9+4) are deliberately non-contiguous specifically so no two consecutive digits ever share a style, guaranteeing every line change crosses a boundary; missed this the first time since I only ported the animation *effects* from Aeon Nox 5's file, not the reasoning behind its specific digit groupings. Remapped to the same non-consecutive pattern (0,3,6 / 1,4,7,9 / 2,5,8), verified by hand that no two adjacent digits (including the 9-to-0 wraparound) share a group. 1.28.2: corrected the current-line rotation after frame-by-frame comparison against the real Aeon Nox 5 reference video confirmed a misunderstanding - Aeon Nox 5 applies ONE shared static tilt to the whole line/style-group (identical 4 degrees on every one of its 5 style blocks, start=end=4, time=0 - never actually animated), not a different tilt per word. An earlier version of this file gave each word (part1-4) its own different fixed angle, which looked wrong side by side with the reference footage - now matches Aeon Nox 5 exactly, one rotation per style-group. Also removed the !Container.OnNext + !Container.OnPrevious guard from the visible condition - copied from Aeon Nox 5, where it suppresses Kodi's native list-scroll transition frame for a list that's actually visible/focused; this dialog's list is never visible or focused, so that transition frame never renders for it either way, and the guard may be why the entrance animation was only playing "sporadically" per live testing. Bumped the 3 decorative font sizes (lib/fontinstall.py) from 60-70pt to 82-88pt, closer to Aeon Nox 5's own 76-94pt range, and widened/repositioned the 3 word columns so bigger text does not clip at screen edges. Frame-by-frame video analysis also clarified why "THEN" visibly appears before "WANT" in one Aeon Nox 5 reference clip despite both being part of one single animated string: it is not word-by-word staggered timing, it is a left-to-right reveal effect naturally produced by a single zoom-in-from-small-to-full transform applied to the whole combined line - which this addon's own group-level zoom animation already reproduces the same way, no extra staggering logic needed. 1.28.1: renamed the addon id from script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed to script.cu.lrclyrics.advanced (per user request - "fixed" implied something was broken/one-off, "advanced" better reflects an actively-developed fork). Kodi treats this as a brand new addon - the old one needs to be uninstalled and this one installed fresh, which also means addon settings (DeepL key, sync offset, etc.) reset to defaults. Also trimmed the 4 translated descriptions way down - they used to itemize every individual fix in prose, now they just say this is based on the original CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 plus this fork's own ongoing fixes, and point to the README/news for detail instead of duplicating it. Also updated the RunScript() addon-id references in settings.xml (font install/remove/scraper-test buttons) and script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix's description to match. 1.28.0: major visual-pass milestone. Requires at least 3 words on both sides so a 1-2 word line can't trivially match almost anything. 1.20.0: added a fourth, absolute-last-resort matching tier using Python's standard difflib.SequenceMatcher for a line that's genuinely a near-miss - a wording variant between the two sources rather than a formatting difference. Translation: added a direct Google Translate fallback tier (DeepL to Google to Lingva) since it's the same engine Lingva proxies but doesn't depend on a specific public instance's uptime; translation is now "sticky" for the rest of the session once turned on - a new song reuses its cache or fetches a fresh one automatically, same as pressing "Show translation" manually; a cached Google/Lingva result gets upgraded to DeepL automatically once a DeepL key is available again; the translation panel now fills in progressively as each line arrives instead of staying blank for 20-30s on the Google/Lingva per-line fallback (and this now also correctly finishes for DeepL's single batch call, which was a real bug - the panel used to get stuck showing the original untranslated text until a full reopen); context menu label now toggles between "Show translation" and "Hide translation" instead of always reading the same regardless of state; missing Slovak strings.po entries for the last few versions' new strings (was silently falling back to English) are filled in. Sync offset: fixed a real bug where the offset appeared to reset after the OK/OSD reopen or a next-track change - self.syncadjust is now the single source of truth (read directly from the lyrics file's own [offset:N] tag every time, instead of being split between that tag and a separately-tracked live delta that only one of two code paths knew about); the sync slider now runs in its own dedicated skin window (see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.2.0) instead of the shared DialogSlider.xml also used for volume/seek/brightness elsewhere in Kodi. Other: a fast local .lrc lookup could lose a race against the previous song's GUI thread still cleaning up, silently skipping showing lyrics (and therefore translation) entirely until a manual OK/OSD reopen forced a retry - now waits up to ~2s for that cleanup instead of giving up immediately; left/right on the remote now seeks the track (this dialog was swallowing all input, including the seek that normally works with no dialog open at all), with the same rapid-repeat acceleration as Kodi's video seek OSD (10s / 30s / 60s). 1.9.0: translation now falls back to a free Lingva Translate instance (no key needed, auto-detects source language) when no DeepL key is set, or when DeepL fails/runs out of its one-time character credit - previously it just showed an error in that case. The Lingva instance used is configurable in settings in case the default (lingva.ml) goes down. 1.8.0: added an optional, off-by-default lyrics translation feature (context menu "Show translation") using the DeepL API - requires an API key set in this addon's settings. On-demand only (never fetched automatically per song, to avoid burning API quota on tracks you don't care about), and the result is cached as a plain text file alongside the addon's own saved lyrics so it's only translated once per song. 1.7.0: now declares script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix as a real add-on dependency, so Kodi installs it automatically alongside this one instead of it being an easy-to-miss separate manual step - it still needs to be run once from Program add-ons to actually patch the skin (can't auto-patch a third-party skin without the user's OK). Also now auto-disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on every Kodi startup if it's found installed and enabled, since the two can't both run as the lyrics service - previously this conflict had to be resolved manually. 1.6.0: up/down during timed lyrics now opens the same on-screen slider dialog used by the context menu's "Sync" option, instead of silently nudging a hidden offset and popping a "Sync offset: +0.5s" notification that didn't say which direction was which. The slider dialog has a static "LATER <---- SYNC OFFSET ----> EARLIER" legend plus a live readout ("Lyrics play Xs earlier/later"/"In sync"), auto-closes after 4s of no input, and the slider step matches the old 0.5s nudge. 1.5.2: clear the previous song's lyrics from the screen immediately on song change, instead of leaving the old lyrics visible for the few seconds get_lyrics() can take to run scraper lookups for the new song. 1.5.1: fixed the same native Kodi crash as 1.5.0 recurring, because 1.5.0 only excluded the ".offset(N)" + "MusicPlayer.Duration" combination while the next-song lyrics prefetch (Song.next(), added for the duration-aware filtering in 1.4.0) still queried Title/Artist/Lyrics/Property with ".offset(1)" - it turns out any MusicPlayer/Player info label combined with ".offset(N)" is unsafe on this Kodi build, not just Duration. Song.next() is now disabled entirely (returns None) instead of trying to fix each individual label one crash at a time - prefetching next-song lyrics was a minor head-start optimization, not essential, since lyrics still get fetched reactively the moment the next track actually starts. 1.5.0: fixed a Kodi crash (native SIGSEGV inside CGUIInfoManager::GetMultiInfoLabel, called via xbmc.getInfoLabel from Python) observed shortly after Song.by_offset() queried "MusicPlayer.offset(N).Duration" for the prefetched next-song lookup added in 1.4.0's duration-aware filtering. That exact info label combination (Duration + a non-zero offset) is far less established than plain "MusicPlayer.Duration", so duration is now only fetched for the current song (offset 0) rather than trying to root-cause a native crash inside Kodi itself. 1.4.0: restored manual lyrics sync correction - the old scrolltosync() feature relied on the lyrics list having native focus (self.controlId == 110) to read a manually-navigated line's timestamp, which was dead code ever since focus was disabled in 1.0.0 for the OK-button/OSD fix, so up/down did nothing for out-of-sync (but correct-edit) timed lyrics. Up/down during timed lyrics now directly nudges a saved offset (with an on-screen readout) instead of depending on focus. Also added duration-aware filtering to the lrclib and musixmatchlrc scrapers so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) with a different length is rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. 1.3.0: fixed plain (untimed) txt lyrics getting stuck showing only the first line forever - a regression from the 1.0.0 OK-button/OSD fix, which disabled focus on the lyrics list so onFocus() (and the up/down scroll handling that depended on it) never fired. Timed LRC lyrics were unaffected since those auto-scroll via a timer regardless of focus. Up/down now moves the txt lyrics selection directly. 1.2.0: fixed a false-positive match in the Music163 scraper - it sometimes only has songwriter/composer credit lines in its lyric DB (e.g. "作词 : ..." / "作曲 : ...") with no actual lyrics, but returned them as if they were valid, blocking the real Genius/musixmatch result from being tried. Now checks the returned lyric actually has content beyond credit lines. 1.1.0: fixed a bug where the lrclib.net scraper could crash with an uncaught TypeError when the API returned an unexpected (non-list) response, which silently aborted the entire remaining lyrics search cascade (musixmatch, genius, supermusic, etc. never got tried). The lrclib scraper is now defensive against bad responses, and both scraper loops in gui.py now catch exceptions per-provider so one broken source can no longer block the rest. 1.0.0: fork of upstream 6.7.1. Fixed OK button being swallowed by lyrics dialog focus; OK now shows OSD and lyrics auto-resume when OSD closes.

extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork with OK/OSD, sync, and scraper reliability fixes (Aeon Nox 5 only)
extension.description: Built and tested for the Aeon Nox 5 skin only. All-in-one: lyrics, on-demand translation, and the Aeon Nox 5 skin patches needed for full compatibility (translation panel, topbar fix, rotating fanart, diacritics, OSD Lyrics button) are all built into this single addon - nothing else to install separately, and it patches the skin automatically on first Kodi startup after install (formerly a separate companion addon, script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix, merged in here 2026-09-10 - a mutual dependency between the two caused Kodi's addon installer to freeze the whole GUI thread when installing either one). Fork of CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (original by Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) with several fixes applied on top: (1) the OK button on the remote no longer gets swallowed by the lyrics dialog's stolen input focus, and pressing OK now shows the music OSD/menu, with the lyrics view automatically reopening afterwards instead of requiring a full navigation reset; (2) manual sync offset correction (up/down during timed lyrics) restored after that same focus change had silently broken it, opening a dedicated on-screen slider; left/right seeks the track (10s/30s/1min with rapid-repeat acceleration, like Kodi's video OSD) with its own transient progress-bar overlay showing position/elapsed/total time, and the lyric line now immediately follows any seek instead of catching up several seconds later; (3) plain (untimed) txt lyrics no longer get stuck showing only the first line forever; (4) several scraper reliability fixes - a crash in the lrclib.net scraper that could silently abort the entire remaining fallback chain, a Music163 false-positive that returned songwriter-credit-only text as if it were real lyrics, and duration-aware filtering so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) gets rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. Automatically disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on startup if found installed and enabled, since the two conflict as lyrics service. Optional on-demand lyrics translation via DeepL (off by default, needs your own API key) is available from the context menu, shown in an on-screen panel whose skin patch (see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) has only been tested on Aeon Nox 5 - other skins will still get working lyrics, but the translation panel and topbar fix need that skin. A single "Interface & translation language" setting (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) picks both this add-on's own menus/notifications and the default lyrics translation target - independent of Kodi's own system language. Translation prefers real human translations (LyricsTranslate.com, and for Slovak/Czech also KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz) over DeepL/Google/Lingva machine translation whenever one is found and lines up with the original; for a Slovak or Czech target with no human translation in that exact language, the nearest Czech<->Slovak translation is used instead, since the two languages are close enough to be a better stand-in than a machine translation. See this repository's README and the version history below for details.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork s opravami OK/OSD, synchronizace a spolehlivosti stahovačů
extension.description: Fork CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (originál od Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) s několika opravami navíc: (1) tlačítko OK na dálkovém ovladači už nepohltí ukradené zaměření dialogu s textem písně a stisknutí OK nyní zobrazí hudební OSD/menu, přičemž se zobrazení textu poté automaticky znovu otevře, místo aby vyžadovalo úplný reset navigace; (2) ruční korekce synchronizačního posunu (nahoru/dolů během časovaného textu) obnovena poté, co ji stejná změna zaměření tiše rozbila - nyní otevírá vlastní posuvník na obrazovce; doleva/doprava přetáčí skladbu (10 s/30 s/1 min se zrychlením při rychlém opakovaném stisku, podobně jako video OSD v Kodi) s vlastním dočasným překryvem s ukazatelem průběhu zobrazujícím pozici/uplynulý/celkový čas, a řádek textu nyní okamžitě následuje jakékoli přetočení místo dohánění o několik sekund později; (3) obyčejný (nečasovaný) TXT text už neuvízne navždy na zobrazení jen první řádky; (4) několik oprav spolehlivosti stahovačů - pád ve stahovači lrclib.net, který mohl tiše přerušit celý zbývající řetězec záložních zdrojů, falešně pozitivní výsledek Music163, který vracel pouze řádky s autorskými zásluhami jako by šlo o skutečný text, a filtrování podle délky skladby, takže shoda názvu/interpreta s jinou verzí (rádiová edice, remix, prodloužená verze) je odmítnuta místo toho, aby vznikl špatně synchronizovaný text. Při spuštění automaticky vypne původní script.cu.lrclyrics, pokud je nainstalovaný a povolený, protože oba doplňky si konkurují jako služba pro texty písní. Volitelný překlad textů na vyžádání přes DeepL (ve výchozím stavu vypnutý, vyžaduje vlastní API klíč) je dostupný z kontextové nabídky a zobrazuje se v panelu na obrazovce, jehož úprava skinu (nyní součástí tohoto doplňku) byla testována pouze na Aeon Nox 5 - ostatní skiny budou mít funkční texty písní i tak, ale panel s překladem a oprava horní lišty vyžadují tento skin. Jedno nastavení "Jazyk rozhraní a překladu" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) určuje jak jazyk vlastních menu/oznámení doplňku, tak výchozí cílový jazyk překladu textů - nezávisle na systémovém jazyce Kodi. Překlad upřednostňuje skutečné lidské překlady (LyricsTranslate.com, a pro slovenštinu/češtinu i KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz) před strojovým překladem DeepL/Google/Lingva, kdykoli se nějaký najde a sedí s originálem; pokud pro slovenský nebo český cíl neexistuje lidský překlad přesně v tomto jazyce, použije se nejbližší česko-slovenský překlad místo toho, protože jsou si oba jazyky dost blízké na to, aby byly lepší náhradou než strojový překlad. Podrobnosti najdete v README tohoto repozitáře a v historii verzí níže.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, Fork mit Korrekturen für OK/OSD, Synchronisation und Quellenzuverlässigkeit
extension.description: Fork von CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (Original von Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) mit mehreren zusätzlichen Korrekturen: (1) die OK-Taste der Fernbedienung wird nicht mehr vom gestohlenen Eingabefokus des Songtext-Dialogs verschluckt, und ein Druck auf OK zeigt nun das Musik-OSD/Menü an, wobei die Songtextansicht danach automatisch wieder geöffnet wird, statt einen kompletten Navigations-Reset zu erfordern; (2) manuelle Synchronisationskorrektur (Hoch/Runter während zeitgesteuerter Songtexte) wiederhergestellt, nachdem dieselbe Fokusänderung sie stillschweigend kaputt gemacht hatte - öffnet jetzt einen eigenen Schieberegler auf dem Bildschirm; Links/Rechts spult den Titel (10 s/30 s/1 min mit Beschleunigung bei schnell wiederholtem Drücken, wie beim Video-OSD von Kodi) mit einer eigenen kurzzeitigen Fortschrittsbalken-Einblendung, die Position/verstrichene/Gesamtzeit anzeigt, und die Songtextzeile folgt jetzt sofort jedem Spulen, statt erst nach mehreren Sekunden aufzuholen; (3) einfache (nicht zeitgesteuerte) TXT-Songtexte bleiben nicht mehr für immer bei der ersten Zeile hängen; (4) mehrere Zuverlässigkeitskorrekturen bei den Quellen - ein Absturz im lrclib.net-Scraper, der die gesamte restliche Fallback-Kette stillschweigend abbrechen konnte, ein Music163-Fehlalarm, der reine Textdichter-/Komponisten-Credit-Zeilen als echten Songtext zurückgab, und eine längenbasierte Filterung, sodass eine Titel-/Interpreten-Übereinstimmung mit einer anderen Version (Radioedit, Remix, Extended Version) abgelehnt wird, statt schlecht synchronisierten Songtext zu erzeugen. Deaktiviert beim Start automatisch das ursprüngliche script.cu.lrclyrics, falls installiert und aktiviert, da beide als Songtext-Dienst in Konflikt stehen. Eine optionale Songtext-Übersetzung auf Abruf via DeepL (standardmäßig deaktiviert, benötigt einen eigenen API-Schlüssel) ist über das Kontextmenü verfügbar und wird in einem Bildschirmpanel angezeigt, dessen Skin-Patch (jetzt Teil dieses Add-ons) nur mit Aeon Nox 5 getestet wurde - andere Skins erhalten trotzdem funktionierende Songtexte, aber das Übersetzungspanel und die Titelleisten-Korrektur benötigen diesen Skin. Eine einzige Einstellung "Oberflächen- und Übersetzungssprache" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) legt sowohl die Sprache der eigenen Menüs/Benachrichtigungen dieses Add-ons als auch die Standard-Zielsprache der Songtext-Übersetzung fest - unabhängig von der Systemsprache von Kodi. Die Übersetzung bevorzugt echte menschliche Übersetzungen (LyricsTranslate.com, für Slowakisch/Tschechisch zusätzlich KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz) gegenüber der maschinellen Übersetzung via DeepL/Google/Lingva, sobald eine gefunden wird und zum Original passt; gibt es für ein slowakisches oder tschechisches Ziel keine menschliche Übersetzung in genau dieser Sprache, wird stattdessen die jeweils andere (Tschechisch/Slowakisch) verwendet, da sich beide Sprachen nahe genug sind, um ein besserer Ersatz als eine maschinelle Übersetzung zu sein. Details siehe README dieses Repositorys und die Versionshistorie unten.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork con correcciones de OK/OSD, sincronización y fiabilidad de buscadores
extension.description: Fork de CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (original de Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) con varias correcciones añadidas: (1) el botón OK del mando ya no queda absorbido por el foco de entrada robado del diálogo de la letra, y al pulsar OK ahora se muestra el OSD/menú de música, reabriéndose después automáticamente la vista de la letra en lugar de requerir un reinicio completo de la navegación; (2) se restauró la corrección manual del desfase de sincronización (Arriba/Abajo durante letras sincronizadas) después de que ese mismo cambio de foco la rompiera silenciosamente, abriendo ahora un control deslizante propio en pantalla; Izquierda/Derecha avanza o retrocede la canción (10 s/30 s/1 min con aceleración al pulsar repetidamente, como el OSD de vídeo de Kodi) con su propia superposición temporal de barra de progreso que muestra posición/tiempo transcurrido/tiempo total, y la línea de la letra ahora sigue el avance o retroceso de inmediato en lugar de ponerse al día varios segundos después; (3) las letras TXT normales (sin sincronizar) ya no se quedan atascadas mostrando solo la primera línea para siempre; (4) varias correcciones de fiabilidad en los buscadores - un fallo en el buscador lrclib.net que podía interrumpir silenciosamente toda la cadena de alternativas restante, un falso positivo de Music163 que devolvía líneas de créditos de autoría como si fueran la letra real, y un filtrado según la duración para que una coincidencia de título/artista con una edición distinta (edición de radio, remix, versión extendida) se rechace en lugar de producir una letra mal sincronizada. Desactiva automáticamente el script.cu.lrclyrics original al iniciar si está instalado y activado, ya que ambos entran en conflicto como servicio de letras. La traducción de letras opcional bajo demanda mediante DeepL (desactivada por defecto, necesita tu propia clave de API) está disponible desde el menú contextual y se muestra en un panel en pantalla cuyo parche de skin (ahora incluido en este complemento) solo se ha probado con Aeon Nox 5 - otros skins seguirán teniendo letras funcionales, pero el panel de traducción y la corrección de la barra superior necesitan ese skin. Un único ajuste "Idioma de interfaz y traducción" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) elige tanto el idioma de los propios menús/notificaciones de este complemento como el idioma de destino predeterminado para la traducción de letras - independientemente del idioma del sistema de Kodi. La traducción prioriza traducciones humanas reales (LyricsTranslate.com, y para eslovaco/checo también KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz) sobre la traducción automática de DeepL/Google/Lingva siempre que se encuentre una y coincida con el original; si para un destino eslovaco o checo no existe una traducción humana en ese idioma exacto, se usa en su lugar la traducción checo-eslovaca más cercana, ya que ambos idiomas son lo bastante parecidos como para ser un mejor sustituto que una traducción automática. Consulta el README de este repositorio y el historial de versiones a continuación para más detalles.

1.24.4: fixed a real bug in the KaraokeTexty scraper - _karaoketexty_find_url() used to scrape the site's own crude '/search?q=artist+title' HTML results page, which for a well-known song frequently returns a lower-quality duplicate entry (bare original lyrics, no translation column at all) instead of the real, properly-categorized page that actually has one, confirmed live for AC/DC - Back in Black. Found (by reading the site's own JS) that its search box autocomplete actually calls a separate, much better JSON search API (search.karaoketexty.cz), and that the site redirects ANY URL for a song's real numeric id to its own correct canonical artist/title slug regardless of what slug text is in the request - so this no longer scrapes a results page or guesses a slug at all: queries the real JSON API by title (an artist+title combined query returned nothing for this API, title alone works and ranks the real match first by view count), matches the returned artist label against the actual artist (handling the site's own 'ϟ' stand-in for a literal '/' in that field), then fetches a dummy-slug URL with that id and follows the site's own redirect to get the correct final URL. Confirmed live: now finds and successfully aligns 57 real Slovak translation lines for AC/DC - Back in Black (translator credited: Azurit), where it previously always fell through to machine translation. 1.24.3: fixed a real bug found live - Song.by_offset() unconditionally replaced every '/' and '\\' in the artist/title read from Kodi's MusicPlayer.Artist/.Title infolabels with ' & ', silently corrupting any real band name containing a literal slash (confirmed live: AC/DC's tag became "AC & DC" in every lyrics/translation search, which no site recognizes - KaraokeTexty and LyricsTranslate both returned wrong-song or no-result matches until this was found and fixed). Kodi's own library scanner already splits genuine multi-artist tags using its configured multi-artist separators and rejoins them for this infolabel, so blindly replacing '/' a second time here was never correct - removed entirely, '/' now passes through untouched. Also added: the "Interface & translation language" setting now auto-detects and matches Kodi's own system/skin language once, on first service startup after install (a marker file in the addon's profile dir, not the setting itself, tracks whether this has run) - the setting remains fully manually changeable afterward exactly as before, this only changes the one-time default. 1.24.2: "Test scrapers" (addon settings, Expert category) now offers to disable any scraper that failed its test, instead of just reporting which ones failed with no way to act on it from there - per user request. Asks first (yesno) rather than disabling automatically, since a single test run against one hardcoded test song each isn't proof a scraper is permanently broken (could be a temporary outage or just that one test song missing from that one site). New string #32195. 1.24.1: fixed the deepl_api_key setting field not appearing in the settings UI at all (not a crash - it just silently failed to register and was invisible, even after the 1.23.4 fix). Real cause per kodi.wiki/view/Add-on_settings_conversion: a type="string" setting with a genuinely empty default needs an explicit true block, or Kodi's CSettingString validator rejects the empty default as invalid and drops the setting entirely - confirmed live, save_lyrics_path elsewhere in this same file already had this exact pattern for the same reason. Also fixed the "Test scrapers" settings button still calling RunScript(script.cu.lrclyrics,test) - the pre-fork original addon id, not this fork's own. 1.24.0: merged script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix directly into this addon (new lib/skinfix.py, resources/skinfile/, called from default.py's startup branch before gui.MAIN() takes over) and retired it as a separate addon entirely. Root cause: the two addons required each other by (confirmed intentional by design, both needed together), but that mutual/circular dependency made Kodi's addon-dependency resolver hang the entire GUI thread indefinitely when installing EITHER one from the repo - confirmed live 2026-09-10 via kodi.log (GUI activity just stops dead the instant Install is pressed on either addon's info dialog, no error, no crash, only `systemctl restart kodi` recovers it - reproduced twice). Removing the addon.xml circularity by merging into one addon removes the hang at its root instead of working around Kodi's dependency resolver. Installing this addon on a fresh Aeon Nox 5 box now needs zero manual steps and zero risk of the install-time freeze: nothing else to install, and the skin patches apply automatically on first Kodi startup after install (still offers a restart-now prompt if anything changed, same as the old addon did). 1.23.5: bumped the required script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix version from 1.9.0 (stale) to 1.15.0 to match what's actually current in this repository - the mismatch made Kodi's dependency installer request a specific old package filename that no longer exists there, failing the whole install with "failed to install dependency script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix", confirmed live. addon.xml description (en_US) now states this addon is Aeon Nox 5-only and auto-installs its required companion, previously only implied deep in the description text. 1.23.4: fixed a TypeError: Invalid setting type crash in get_settings() on deepl_api_key/lingva_instance - a malformed empty in settings.xml (now ), which crashed MAIN.__init__() entirely on a fresh install with no key ever entered, taking down lyrics display along with translation; both reads also now wrapped in try/except TypeError so a missing/bad setting can never take the whole service down again. 1.23.3: swapped the per-line machine-filled marker from "† " to "» " per user preference. 1.23.2: hybrid results now mark each individual machine-filled line with a "† " prefix directly in the translation panel, not just as an aggregate percentage in the source strip - confirmed font_translation (NotoSans-Regular) actually has this glyph via its own cmap table before picking it; several tried symbols (gear/star/diamond/lightning, and an actual emoji) are missing from this font and would have rendered as empty boxes. 1.23.1: fixed a real bug found live - a hybrid result's DeepL gap-fill could land in the wrong language even with 1.22.1's cross-fallback fix, because that fix trusted the KaraokeTexty DOMAIN (.sk vs .cz) to know what language its own content is in, and that isn't reliable: confirmed live, karaoketexty.sk served an entirely Czech-language translation column for one song (verified via Czech-only vs Slovak-only diacritic characters - 30 cz-only, 0 sk-only - despite the .sk domain and no cross-fallback suffix on the source name), so the gap-fill correctly followed the addon's Slovak target language while the human-covered lines it was supplementing were actually Czech. human_translation_lang() now detects the ACTUAL fetched content's language via that same diacritic heuristic first, only falling back to the source-name suffix or target_lang when the text is too short/plain to tell (no distinguishing diacritics at all). 1.23.0: fixed a real bug found live - repeating the exact same track (repeat-one, or a short playlist looping back to it) did not restart CU LRC lyrics OR the translation panel at all. Root cause was two separate identity checks that only ever compare artist+title: myPlayerChanged() treated the repeat as "nothing changed" since Song.__eq__ doesn't know about actual playback restarting, so it never even re-fetched lyrics; and even after fixing that, a fresh GUI instance's reset_controls() also only compares an artist|title fingerprint to decide whether to preserve an already-showing translation (needed for the OK/OSD reopen of a still-playing song), which can't tell that apart from a genuine repeat either, and would leave the translation panel WIN properties claiming "shown" while the actual (new) list control was empty. onAVStarted now passes a force flag all the way through myPlayerChanged() and the GUI's kwargs (song_restarted) so a genuine new-playback-start event (Kodi fires onAVStarted again even for an exact repeat) always re-triggers both lyrics and translation, while the OK/OSD same-song reopen path (which doesn't go through onAVStarted) keeps its existing preserve-translation behavior. 1.22.2: fixed a real bug found live testing 1.22.1 - is_fully_human_source() used to treat a cached translation as fully human whenever the CURRENT hybrid marker ("[CR]+") was absent from its source string, but a cache file written under an EARLIER hybrid format (" + " and "(NN% / NN%)", before this session's 2-line "[CR]+" display was introduced) doesn't contain that marker either, so it read as "not hybrid" and got frozen as permanently trusted - confirmed live, a song's translation panel was stuck showing the raw old-format string ("KaraokeTexty + DeepL[CR](92% / 8%)") forever and never re-attempted the new bs4 version at all. is_fully_human_source() now checks the source name against an exact whitelist of the fixed fully-human names instead, which can't be fooled by a hybrid format change since it doesn't try to detect what a hybrid name looks like. 1.22.1: bumped the required beautifulsoup4/soupsieve versions to 4.15.0/2.9.2 (was 4.12.2/2.4.1, matching the box's previously-stuck version) to test whether a scraper-matching discrepancy seen live (a line confirmed identical after normalization both locally and via a fresh page re-fetch, yet still reported as a miss on the box) is actually a bs4-version-specific behavior difference. bs4 4.13+ added a hard runtime dependency on typing_extensions (bs4/_typing.py imports it unconditionally, not just under TYPE_CHECKING), so this also adds a new script.module.typing-extensions (4.16.0) vendored addon. 1.22.0: fixed a real language-mixing bug in the hybrid human+DeepL gap-fill (1.18.0) - the gap-fill DeepL call always translated into self.TRANSLATE_LANG (the requested target language), but a KaraokeTexty cross-fallback human result (source name suffixed "(CS)"/"(SK)") is actually in the OTHER of the two languages, so a Slovak target that fell back to the Czech site could end up with Czech human lines and Slovak DeepL-filled lines mixed in the same translation panel. New lib/humantranslate.py human_translation_lang() derives the gap-fill's target language from the actual human source used instead of always assuming target_lang. 1.21.1: fixed a real bug from 1.21.0 - the hybrid source string format changed to "Name (92%)[CR]+ DeepL (8%)" for the new 2-line display, which broke the "[CR]+"-based hybrid detection this update also had to fix in is_fully_human_source(), and the end-of-song credit's DeepL/percentage stripping (previously done by splitting the display string on " + ", which no longer appears literally in the new format). The credit name is now tracked in its own culrc.translation.credit_source property instead of being parsed back out of the display string at all. 1.21.0: the translation-panel source strip (script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml.dat, now a 2-line textbox instead of a single-line label) shows a hybrid "KaraokeTexty + DeepL" result as two lines - the source names, then the human/machine coverage percentage on its own line - instead of a single truncated line. 1.20.1: reworked the fuzzy last-resort tier from a character-level similarity percentage to a word-level diff count (still via difflib.SequenceMatcher, just fed word lists instead of raw strings) - a fixed percentage threshold penalizes short lines unfairly (a single wrong word in a 4-word line can drop the character-ratio to 70-80%, well under any reasonable threshold, while the same single-word difference barely dents a long line's ratio), whereas "at most one differing word" means the same thing regardless of line length, confirmed with both long and short synthetic test lines. Requires at least 3 words on both sides so a 1-2 word line can't trivially match almost anything. 1.20.0: added a fourth, absolute-last-resort matching tier using Python's standard difflib.SequenceMatcher for a line that's genuinely a near-miss - a wording variant between the two sources rather than a formatting difference. Every match now logs which of the four tiers found it. 1.19.1: a hybrid "KaraokeTexty + DeepL" result (see 1.18.0's gap-filling) is no longer cached forever - only a FULLY human match is, since a hybrid one might improve to a better ratio (or full human coverage) later, whether from a matching-logic improvement or the site's own content changing, and re-checking it on the next view is cheap. The end-of-song credit still shows for a cached hybrid result exactly as before, this only changes whether it's re-attempted. 1.19.0: added a third, last-resort content-matching tier for KaraokeTexty alignment - after exact single-line and merge-window matching both fail for a line, tries again with internal whitespace removed too (not just punctuation), catching a word split differently across a line-break or hyphenation quirk between the two sources. This tier is strictly more permissive than the other two (dropping word boundaries can in principle equate two genuinely different phrases), so it only ever runs after they've both already failed for that line, and every match now logs which of the three tiers found it. 1.18.3: the end-of-song translation credit no longer mentions DeepL for a hybrid "KaraokeTexty + DeepL" result - DeepL only filled in a few lines the human source didn't cover, it didn't do the actual translation, so the thank-you message now credits just the human site/translator. 1.18.2: apostrophes are now deleted entirely rather than treated as a word boundary when normalizing lines for comparison - two independently-transcribed sources commonly differ on whether a contraction keeps its apostrophe at all (e.g. "don't" vs "dont"), and unlike other punctuation it sits inside a word, so turning it into a space like the rest would wrongly split one word into two instead of unifying the spellings. 1.18.1: fixed a real bug in the line-merge logic - a "line" that's purely punctuation (e.g. a standalone ellipsis used as its own
-separated line to mark a pause/trail-off, where the original combines it into the surrounding line with a comma instead) normalizes to nothing and has no real content to align on, but keeping it as its own pairs entry broke the merge-window check, which stopped at the first empty entry instead of skipping past it - confirmed live on a real song. These punctuation-only "lines" are now dropped entirely when parsing each column, so real content lines stay adjacent and merge correctly across where they used to sit. 1.18.0: KaraokeTexty content alignment no longer requires 100% coverage to be used at all - a partial human match now keeps every line it did find (tagged e.g. "KaraokeTexty + DeepL") and machine-translates only the specific remaining gaps (e.g. a chorus the fan site never wrote out in the original language, so there was nothing to match against at all), instead of discarding the whole human result and falling back to pure machine translation for the entire song. 1.17.1: widened the line-merge window from 2-3 to 2-5 consecutive site lines when checking whether they combine to match one original line. 1.17.0: KaraokeTexty content alignment now also matches when a single original (timed) line corresponds to several consecutive lines on the fan site - e.g. our LRC has one line combining two short phrases with a comma, while the site writes each phrase as its own
-separated line (confirmed live on a real song, this was a real source of low match rates, not missing content). Exact single-line matches are still tried and applied first; only lines with no direct match fall through to checking 2-3-line merge windows. 1.16.0: once the last timed lyric line has passed, if a human translation source was used (LyricsTranslate/KaraokeTexty, never DeepL/Google/Lingva), shows a "translation by X, support them at Y" credit for ~25s - includes the individual credited translator's name when KaraokeTexty shows one. Fixed a real bug found while adding this: KaraokeTexty's translator-credit link is nested inside the same span as the last translated line with no
separating it, so it was silently glued onto the end of that line's text before this fix, corrupting its content-match against the original. Requires script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.6.0+ for the new skin overlay. 1.15.2: addon description (all 4 translated languages) now mentions the human-translation-first behavior and the Czech<->Slovak cross-fallback, was undocumented before. 1.15.1: normalized punctuation/quote-style before comparing lines for KaraokeTexty content alignment (curly vs straight apostrophes, commas/periods, double spacing) - a single differing character was failing an otherwise-identical line's match, confirmed live (one song matched only 9/32 lines before this fix). 1.15.0: KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz human translations are now aligned by CONTENT instead of only by total line count - the scraper now keeps both the original-language and translated columns (not just the translation) and matches each of the addon's own original lyric lines against KaraokeTexty's original-language lines to find its translation, reusing the same translation for a repeated line (e.g. a chorus sung multiple times) even when the fan site only wrote it out once or twice. Falls back to machine translation only if any original line has no match at all (100% coverage required, no partial results). LyricsTranslate still uses the simpler exact-count check for now, since its original-language text isn't in the same page load. 1.14.4: vendored this addon's module dependencies (beautifulsoup4, chardet, mutagen, requests, and requests'/beautifulsoup4's own sub-dependencies soupsieve/urllib3/certifi/idna) as real addon packages in this repository instead of relying only on Kodi's official repo for them, and bumped the declared minimum versions to match what's actually shipped/tested (was pinned to matrix-era minimums from the original fork, e.g. beautifulsoup4 4.8.2 vs the 4.12.2 actually in use). 1.14.3: fixed a real bug in the KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz scraper - the old bs4 4.8.2 bundled with this Kodi build silently drops some lines when using col.find_all('br') + br.replace_with('\n') on this site's markup (confirmed: modern bs4 gets the full line count from the identical page, old bs4 loses some - reproduced the exact discrepancy directly against bs4==4.8.2). Replaced with a plain regex split on the column's raw inner HTML, which doesn't depend on that bs4 API and gets the correct count on both old and new bs4. 1.14.2: fixed a real bug in the human-translation line-count check for timed lyrics - self.pOverlay (and therefore the original-lines array) includes blank entries for bare timing markers with no lyric text, which a scraped human translation never has, so the comparison was checking against the wrong (too-high) count and would have misaligned every line after the first blank marker had it ever matched. Now compares against the non-empty line count and splices matching human lines back into their original non-empty positions, leaving blank timing-marker slots blank. 1.14.1: fixed a real bug in 1.14.0 - a pre-existing machine-translation cache file (e.g. from before this version) was trusted forever and never re-attempted, so a song already translated once via DeepL/Google/Lingva would never actually try the new human sources at all. Now only a cached HUMAN translation is trusted; any cached DeepL/Google/Lingva result is always re-attempted (human sources first) on the next view. 1.14.0: new lib/humantranslate.py adds human (non-machine) translation sources tried before DeepL/Google/Lingva - LyricsTranslate.com (all 5 addon languages, discovered via a DuckDuckGo site: search since LT's own search is behind an unsolvable Cloudflare challenge from a scripted request) and KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz (Slovak/Czech only, with a Slovak-Czech cross-fallback when only the other of the two exists, since the two languages are close enough to be a better stand-in than machine translation). For timed lyrics, a human translation is only used if its line count matches the original exactly (a human translator doesn't preserve line boundaries the way translating the exact same array does) - otherwise falls through to machine translation as before. For untimed lyrics any line count is fine. A cached human translation is never re-fetched or downgraded. 1.13.2: updated the one-time first-timed-lyrics tip notification (string #32012), which only ever mentioned Up/Down sync and was now stale since 1.10.0 added Left/Right seek - now mentions both. 1.13.1: widened the lyrics sync-offset slider range (context menu "Sync", or up/down on timed lyrics) from ±20s to ±30s. 1.13.0: skip translating lyrics into English when they're already in English (target language = English only) - a cheap stopword-frequency heuristic (lib/translate.py looks_like_english(), not a real language detector) avoids burning DeepL/Google/Lingva quota on a no-op translation, for both manual "Show translation" and "sticky" auto-translate on a new track. Only applied for an English target, since the same short-circuit for the other 4 languages would need a reliable stopword list per language to do safely without risking skipping a translation that was actually needed. 1.12.0: new unified "Interface & translation language" setting (English default, plus Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) - one choice now drives both this add-on's own menus/notifications/dialogs (via a new lib/localization.py that reads the matching resources/language/resource.language.xx_yy/strings.po directly, independent of Kodi's own system language) and the default lyrics translation target language, replacing the old separate free-text translate_lang setting (previously constrained to sk/cs only). Added full cs_CZ, es_ES and de_DE translations (sk_SK and en_GB already existed) plus matching addon.xml description/summary entries for Kodi's Add-ons browser (that part still follows Kodi's system language, a Kodi limitation - only this add-on's own runtime strings follow the new setting). 1.11.2: fixed a real bug - the highlighted lyric line did not reliably follow a seek (either left/right or clicking a line to jump to it). refresh() only ever reschedules its own timer for the NEXT line boundary, computed from the position BEFORE the seek, so the display kept following the pre-seek timeline until that stale timer happened to fire on its own, which could take several seconds and looked like lyrics not reacting to seeking at all. Both seek paths now force an immediate stop_refresh()+refresh() right after seekTime() instead of waiting on the stale timer. 1.11.1: bumped script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix requirement to 1.5.0 for the repositioned/widened seek overlay (no library code change). 1.11.0: left/right seek now shows a transient progress-bar overlay (position on the full track timeline, elapsed/total time, and the +/-10s/30s/1:00 amount just seeked) matching Kodi's own video seek OSD style, auto-hiding after ~1.5s of no further presses - since this dialog swallows the native seek OSD entirely, seeking previously gave no visual feedback at all about where it landed. Requires script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.3.0+ for the new skin controls. 1.10.0: large batch of translation and sync fixes. Translation: added a direct Google Translate fallback tier (DeepL to Google to Lingva) since it's the same engine Lingva proxies but doesn't depend on a specific public instance's uptime; translation is now "sticky" for the rest of the session once turned on - a new song reuses its cache or fetches a fresh one automatically, same as pressing "Show translation" manually; a cached Google/Lingva result gets upgraded to DeepL automatically once a DeepL key is available again; the translation panel now fills in progressively as each line arrives instead of staying blank for 20-30s on the Google/Lingva per-line fallback (and this now also correctly finishes for DeepL's single batch call, which was a real bug - the panel used to get stuck showing the original untranslated text until a full reopen); context menu label now toggles between "Show translation" and "Hide translation" instead of always reading the same regardless of state; missing Slovak strings.po entries for the last few versions' new strings (was silently falling back to English) are filled in. Sync offset: fixed a real bug where the offset appeared to reset after the OK/OSD reopen or a next-track change - self.syncadjust is now the single source of truth (read directly from the lyrics file's own [offset:N] tag every time, instead of being split between that tag and a separately-tracked live delta that only one of two code paths knew about); the sync slider now runs in its own dedicated skin window (see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.2.0) instead of the shared DialogSlider.xml also used for volume/seek/brightness elsewhere in Kodi. Other: a fast local .lrc lookup could lose a race against the previous song's GUI thread still cleaning up, silently skipping showing lyrics (and therefore translation) entirely until a manual OK/OSD reopen forced a retry - now waits up to ~2s for that cleanup instead of giving up immediately; left/right on the remote now seeks the track (this dialog was swallowing all input, including the seek that normally works with no dialog open at all), with the same rapid-repeat acceleration as Kodi's video seek OSD (10s / 30s / 60s). 1.9.0: translation now falls back to a free Lingva Translate instance (no key needed, auto-detects source language) when no DeepL key is set, or when DeepL fails/runs out of its one-time character credit - previously it just showed an error in that case. The Lingva instance used is configurable in settings in case the default (lingva.ml) goes down. 1.8.0: added an optional, off-by-default lyrics translation feature (context menu "Show translation") using the DeepL API - requires an API key set in this addon's settings. On-demand only (never fetched automatically per song, to avoid burning API quota on tracks you don't care about), and the result is cached as a plain text file alongside the addon's own saved lyrics so it's only translated once per song. 1.7.0: now declares script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix as a real add-on dependency, so Kodi installs it automatically alongside this one instead of it being an easy-to-miss separate manual step - it still needs to be run once from Program add-ons to actually patch the skin (can't auto-patch a third-party skin without the user's OK). Also now auto-disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on every Kodi startup if it's found installed and enabled, since the two can't both run as the lyrics service - previously this conflict had to be resolved manually. 1.6.0: up/down during timed lyrics now opens the same on-screen slider dialog used by the context menu's "Sync" option, instead of silently nudging a hidden offset and popping a "Sync offset: +0.5s" notification that didn't say which direction was which. The slider dialog has a static "LATER <---- SYNC OFFSET ----> EARLIER" legend plus a live readout ("Lyrics play Xs earlier/later"/"In sync"), auto-closes after 4s of no input, and the slider step matches the old 0.5s nudge. 1.5.2: clear the previous song's lyrics from the screen immediately on song change, instead of leaving the old lyrics visible for the few seconds get_lyrics() can take to run scraper lookups for the new song. 1.5.1: fixed the same native Kodi crash as 1.5.0 recurring, because 1.5.0 only excluded the ".offset(N)" + "MusicPlayer.Duration" combination while the next-song lyrics prefetch (Song.next(), added for the duration-aware filtering in 1.4.0) still queried Title/Artist/Lyrics/Property with ".offset(1)" - it turns out any MusicPlayer/Player info label combined with ".offset(N)" is unsafe on this Kodi build, not just Duration. Song.next() is now disabled entirely (returns None) instead of trying to fix each individual label one crash at a time - prefetching next-song lyrics was a minor head-start optimization, not essential, since lyrics still get fetched reactively the moment the next track actually starts. 1.5.0: fixed a Kodi crash (native SIGSEGV inside CGUIInfoManager::GetMultiInfoLabel, called via xbmc.getInfoLabel from Python) observed shortly after Song.by_offset() queried "MusicPlayer.offset(N).Duration" for the prefetched next-song lookup added in 1.4.0's duration-aware filtering. That exact info label combination (Duration + a non-zero offset) is far less established than plain "MusicPlayer.Duration", so duration is now only fetched for the current song (offset 0) rather than trying to root-cause a native crash inside Kodi itself. 1.4.0: restored manual lyrics sync correction - the old scrolltosync() feature relied on the lyrics list having native focus (self.controlId == 110) to read a manually-navigated line's timestamp, which was dead code ever since focus was disabled in 1.0.0 for the OK-button/OSD fix, so up/down did nothing for out-of-sync (but correct-edit) timed lyrics. Up/down during timed lyrics now directly nudges a saved offset (with an on-screen readout) instead of depending on focus. Also added duration-aware filtering to the lrclib and musixmatchlrc scrapers so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) with a different length is rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. 1.3.0: fixed plain (untimed) txt lyrics getting stuck showing only the first line forever - a regression from the 1.0.0 OK-button/OSD fix, which disabled focus on the lyrics list so onFocus() (and the up/down scroll handling that depended on it) never fired. Timed LRC lyrics were unaffected since those auto-scroll via a timer regardless of focus. Up/down now moves the txt lyrics selection directly. 1.2.0: fixed a false-positive match in the Music163 scraper - it sometimes only has songwriter/composer credit lines in its lyric DB (e.g. "作词 : ..." / "作曲 : ...") with no actual lyrics, but returned them as if they were valid, blocking the real Genius/musixmatch result from being tried. Now checks the returned lyric actually has content beyond credit lines. 1.1.0: fixed a bug where the lrclib.net scraper could crash with an uncaught TypeError when the API returned an unexpected (non-list) response, which silently aborted the entire remaining lyrics search cascade (musixmatch, genius, supermusic, etc. never got tried). The lrclib scraper is now defensive against bad responses, and both scraper loops in gui.py now catch exceptions per-provider so one broken source can no longer block the rest. 1.0.0: fork of upstream 6.7.1. Fixed OK button being swallowed by lyrics dialog focus; OK now shows OSD and lyrics auto-resume when OSD closes.
